Starting Q1 2027, AOI will ship U.S.-made products, with some laser diodes supporting advanced co-packaged optics from 1988. CEO Dr. Thompson Lin called it 'meaningful long-term revenue and demand visibility' in the AI infrastructure world, and shares rose 2.6% to 5% on the news despite a dip in tech indices.

data.hook: Developers are thrilled to run a top-tier AI coding model on everyday laptops without cloud costs or overheating hardware.
data.name: Inkling 2 Mini Brings Powerful AI Coding to Laptops
data.summary: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini on November 20, a 26.4 billion parameter model that fits on machines with 16GB RAM or less, thanks to its looped transformer design for efficient reasoning. It leads open-weight models under 100B parameters on coding benchmarks like 48.2% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified, with users praising its Opus-level coding and 24/7 web scraping on MacBook Pros. Community tools from Unsloth and Atomic Chat boost speeds to 125 tokens per second, while uncensored versions enable unrestricted offline use. Founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, the Apache 2.0-licensed model signals a push for powerful local AI free from cloud dependency.

data.name: Supertake Raises $20M Seed with Coinbase Veterans as New Co-Founders

Beta users are already putting real money into shareable portfolios via linked Coinbase and Robinhood accounts, with founders personally investing hundreds of thousands to back the vision of a meritocratic ideas economy.

data.hook: Imagine AI wiping out jobs on a massive scale, with video games as the suggested escape hatch. Anthropic's Dario Amodei floated this idea in old Slack messages, sparking widespread online pushback.
data.name: Anthropic CEO Suggests Video Games to Ease AI Job Losses
data.summary: In a Wall Street Journal profile, Amodei recalled suggesting immersive video games to keep people occupied if AI triggers widespread unemployment, drawing from his OpenAI days. He has warned AI could eliminate half of entry-level white-collar jobs and push U.S. unemployment to 10-20 percent soon. Reactions ranged from skepticism about AI's job impact to calls for universal basic income, with jokes about a 'funest Great Depression' and nods to Ready Player One. The debate highlights fears of economic fallout outpacing solutions for displaced workers.

data.name: Venice.ai Doubles Revenue Run Rate to $200 Million in Three Months
data.summary: Just three months after hitting $100 million in August, Venice.ai reached a $200 million run rate, with community trackers estimating $204.3 million based on on-chain data. The platform offers chat, image, video, and code tools across hundreds of models, prioritizing user privacy by avoiding server storage or data training, and users pay via subscriptions from $18 to $200 or API credits. Investor Haseeb Qureshi called it one of the fastest-growing products he's backed, fueled by surging usage and tied to its $VVV token through buybacks and burns. Founded in 2024 by Voorhees of ShapeShift, the company raised $65 million at a $1 billion valuation and stays profitable.

data.name: TermiX Builds On-Chain Marketplace for AI Agents
data.summary: TermiX's Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol lets AI agents bid on jobs, lock payments in on-chain escrow, submit deliverables via hashes, and resolve disputes through evaluator panels, all while building public reputation scores. Recent additions include Binance Agent ID logins and a BOT Chain partnership for task outsourcing, as the final Katalyst campaign epoch wraps up with points for activity.

data.hook: AI shopping agents are making their own picks, and once people greenlight that first buy, they often return for more—up to 78% after nine purchases.
data.name: AI Agents Shop Independently and Users Keep Coming Back
data.summary: A new a16z study tested agents like Grok Bot, Muse, Instinct, and Dots on over 1,270 prompts, finding they prioritize price (43% of decisions) and reviews over brand names. Stripe data shows repeat agent spending surged nearly 80-fold from early September to mid-November 2026, with travel sites like Expedia leading early volume and retailers like Walmart gaining ground. Walmart launched its Agent Gateway to welcome agents with easy connections and user controls, unlike Amazon's restrictions, while businesses adapt by offering guest checkout and clear pricing to win these digital shoppers.

data.hook: A simple chart reveals founder-led companies delivering 25% annual returns since 2016, double the S&P 500's pace. Balaji Srinivasan calls this gap an empirical fact worth rethinking business norms.
data.name: Founder-Led Companies Outperform Professional Managers, Data Shows
data.summary: Data from public stocks and venture-backed startups shows founder CEOs driving far higher returns than hired managers, with 25% annualized gains for founder-led public firms versus 13.6% for the S&P 500, and 22.4% valuation growth in startups compared to 4.7%. Srinivasan argues today's tech landscape makes founders irreplaceable while companies are easy to replicate, pushing for governance that favors founder control and dual-class stocks over traditional boards. While some highlight boards' role in long-term guidance and question data biases, the trend underscores founder-led innovation's edge in delivering shareholder value.

data.summary: Figure AI CEO Brett Adcock shared a video of their Helix robot picking up an apple even after the table shifted, directly addressing Musk's recent claim that current demos would fail such a test. The feat was zero-shot, meaning no prior training on that exact scene, as confirmed by Figure's AI Director Corey Lynch. While some praise the adaptability, skeptics wonder if a lab setup truly proves reliability in messy, unfamiliar homes. The exchange underscores the race in humanoid robotics to handle surprises without scripts.

data.name: Embo Launches with $110M to Build AI Brains for Robots
data.summary: Embo emerged from stealth on November 23, 2026, raising a $110 million seed round led by a16z to develop frontier AI models as the 'brain' for general-purpose robots. Founder Danijar Hafner, from Google DeepMind's Dreamer series, and co-founder Wilson Yan, from VideoGPT at DeepMind and Meta, lead a team from NVIDIA, MIT, and more. Their approach pretrains on internet-scale video and text, practices skills in simulations, then fine-tunes on real humanoids—aiming for adaptable robots that promise more accessible goods and services. Backers like Khosla Ventures and NVIDIA see it sparking a robotics revolution.

data.summary: Enterprise AI firm Sierra, co-founded by Bret Taylor, closed a $1.75 billion Series F round led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners, doubling its valuation to $30 billion from May. The company now serves nearly half of the Fortune 50 with conversational AI agents that handle tasks like customer service, loan origination, and insurance claims using an outcome-based pricing model. Revenue hit a $400 million run-rate after doubling twice in under a year, drawing praise for its traction with regulated giants like banks and insurers. The funds will fuel platform development amid rising demand for practical AI solutions.

data.hook: Six-month-old startup Marlowe just landed the biggest seed round this week, betting big on factories that make AI run faster and cheaper in everyday apps.
data.name: Marlowe Raises $277 Million Seed for AI Inference Factories
data.summary: Co-founders Dan Lewis, from freight startup Convoy, and Kutta Srinivasan, ex-Microsoft AI lead, raised $277 million led by Accel, valuing Marlowe at $1.15 billion. They're building specialized factories using chips from AMD and Etched to handle AI inference tasks like coding and reasoning more efficiently than Nvidia-focused data centers. The first site launches in December for AI coding customers, with more capacity in 2027, as investors eye solutions to the growing gap between AI demand and compute supply.
